title: Release the settlement test hook on its normal thread stack before TLS teardown
outcome: A settlement hook capturing test AppState cannot make its last drop occur in thread-local destructor context.
acceptance: The request-scoped test hook is cleared or otherwise releases captured AppState on a normal stack, including relevant unwind paths, without changing non-test durability behavior.
Affected receipt and durability tests pass, preserving actual ACK/release synchronization, WAL/history and exact stale-selection409 assertions.
